title: The US Has 165 Volcanoes, More Than Indonesia
hook: The US, not Indonesia, leads with 165 volcanoes.
closing: Volcano fame follows eruptions, but the count tells a different story.
question: Which country would you have guessed?

segments.say: The United States has 165 volcanoes. That puts it ahead of every other country in this count.
Alaska alone contains 130 volcanoes. One state drives most of the US lead.
The Ring of Fire holds 75% of Earth's volcanoes. That geography lifts several countries near the top.
